name: wash-bottle
why: Curves in a real part: a turned body drawn as one section with a rounded base corner, a spline shoulder and a through-arc bead, hollowed by a second curved section, with a pipe along a spline spout bored by the same spline. One body, no voids: the bore meets the cavity and opens at the tip, which the section view shows; a bore sealed at both ends would read as a void, one sealed at the tip only would not, which is why the section is the other half of this check.
